reviews.text: Our 1 year teckel stayed with Stef for a week and had a great time (good stay, beach walks, good care). I can recommend! Thank you for everything.

We are moving and would love to take Stef with us.

Stef is a real star: reliable, meticulous, always on time, and she keeps her promises. Her communication is clear and straightforward. Her van is well-maintained and clean.

She puts the pack together with care and has the dogs perfectly under control. Our dog Ruby – who is normally afraid of everything – quickly recognized the sound of Stef's van and would run excitedly to the front door. The walks are long and varied, and Ruby always came home satisfied and wonderfully tired.

I can recommend Stef 100% in every respect.

I have sent my dog to Stef since he was a puppy, he learned so much from the group walks. It made him better at socialisation, he knows how to be around dogs now and in general is a well rounded doggo. He also LOVES Stef, literally vibrates with happiness everytime she comes to pick him up. Would recommend over and over again.

In April we went on a trip to Amsterdam with our little dog and since we couldn't take him with us to most of the tourist attractions, we started looking for someone to take care of him and we were really lucky to find the lovely Stephanie. …

Our dog Jimmy goes with Stef twice a week. It is truly fantastic! He even gets excited just by seeing the bus drive by in town. Contact with Stef is always very easy, and she is very reliable. Furthermore, the whole family enjoys the videos she always makes after every walk! Many thanks for your excellent care, Stef! The Derksen Family

Wow, what a warm welcome!!! I approached Stef after visiting a few other places, and without knowing it beforehand, she is everything Boef, but also we, could wish for! Attention, humor, knowledge, warmth... basically everything!
My little dog Pai is super happy every time he gets picked up by Stefs Dogz!! And... he comes home completely satisfied :)
A really great dog walking service! Our dog comes home blissfully tired in the evening!
